@title VIONATrader
 @notice On-chain CFD position manager for tokenized capital markets.
 Users deposit USDG as collateral to open long or short positions on
 tokenized stocks. Profit/loss is settled in USDG at close using the
 on-chain VIONAPriceFeed oracle.
 Integration with VIONA Shield:
   1. User calls ShieldedPool.spend() with recipient = this contract's
      pendingDeposit address, OR
   2. User unshields to wallet, approves USDG, calls openPosition() directly.
 Price precision: 6 decimals (1_000_000 = $1.00 USDG)
 USDG decimals:   6
Protocol fee: 0.1% of collateral at open
